name: Flower Decorated Shoulder Bag – Trendy & Unique Large Capacity Tote RM130
description:
Type:  Tote Bag
Style: Trendy 
Design: Flower Decoration, Rattan Weave
Material: Fabric (with rattan accents)
Size: Bottom Width 28 cm × Top Width 30 cm × Height 26 cm × Thickness 8 cm (manual measurement, allow 1–3 cm error)
Handle Height: 33.5 cm
Weight: 0.18 kg
Color Options: White, Khaki, Green
Capacity: Mobile phones, wallets, cosmetics, and small personal items
Carry Type: Shoulder
Chamber: Single compartment

Key Features:

Spacious Interior: Large capacity for all your daily essentials.

Trendy & Unique: Flower-decorated design with rattan accents for a fashionable look.

Lightweight & Durable: Easy to carry with sturdy fabric and handle.

Versatile Use: Ideal for leisure, commuting, school, vacation, or casual outings.

Comfortable Carry: Shoulder strap handle for convenient daily use.
